posts.text: drop me in a hostage negotiation and i'll have every demand met in four minutes, mostly because my aries mars cannot physically sit through a second phone call. you're welcome, everyone is free x
posts.caption: Patience was never on the table

posts.text: effective immediately, my aries placements are stepping down from the escape room. we got out in nine minutes by kicking the door, which staff are calling 'not the intended solution' x
posts.caption: Cardinal fire always finds the shortcut

posts.text: dating an aries venus is incredible because they'll chase you across three states and a time zone, then the second you text back first they quietly lose interest and take up pottery
posts.caption: The chase was the whole personality

posts.text: my aries moon has a strict feelings policy: we yell for six minutes, apologise for none of it, then ask if you want tacos like the last ten minutes were a different weather system
posts.caption: Mood passed. Tacos remain.

posts.text: per my last email, my aries rising did not 'storm into the meeting'. i entered the room at my natural walking speed, which happens to be the speed of a minor emergency
posts.caption: Aries rising walks like the building is on fire

posts.text: put an aries on a jury and we'll have a verdict before the opening statements finish. guilty, not guilty, honestly whatever, the important thing is that we were first
posts.caption: Justice, but make it a race

posts.text: and here we observe the aries in its natural habitat, starting an argument in the group chat at 1am, winning it, forgetting it, then sleeping peacefully like a newborn ram
posts.caption: Zero thoughts after the victory lap

posts.text: as your aries coworker i'd like to clarify that i do not have a temper. i have a very fast reply-all button and a deep personal hatred of meetings that could have been settled by arm wrestling
posts.caption: Efficient, alarming and somehow still beloved

posts.text: by royal decree of the aries sun, the astrological new year begins in march, the calendar is wrong, and january has been formally downgraded to a soft launch
posts.caption: Aries season is the real new year, sorry

posts.text: airport security asked my aries mars to step aside for additional screening and honestly fair, i did sprint to the gate like it owed me money and our flight is in three hours
posts.caption: Boarding group: right now, actually

posts.text: as the aries best man i'd like to raise a glass to the happy couple, and to the fact that i objected out loud before the officiant even got to that part. i stand by the timing
posts.caption: Speaking first, thinking at some point

posts.text: an aries friend will drive across town at 2am to defend your honour, then call you the next morning like 'wait, what was his name again'. loyalty, not memory
posts.caption: Ride or die, mostly ride

posts.text: by entering a relationship with an aries you agree to the following terms: every board game is a blood sport, every walk is a race, and the loser buys dinner. there is no opt-out x
posts.caption: Read the fine print, if you can keep up

posts.text: today's forecast for your aries friend: sudden heat around noon, a brief and dramatic storm over someone parking badly, then clear skies by two with absolutely no memory of it
posts.caption: Fast front, short memory

posts.text: i have been summoned to small claims court by my own to-do list, which alleges my aries sun started eleven projects this month and abandoned all eleven with 'alarming enthusiasm'
posts.caption: Pleading enthusiastic, your honour

posts.text: i regret to announce that my taurus moon will not be attending the spontaneous road trip. i have a nap scheduled for 3pm and i do not negotiate with spontaneity x
posts.caption: Plans are for people without blankets

posts.text: put a taurus on a heist crew and we'll spend four months planning, refuse to rush the vault, and walk out with the cash and the cheese board from the bank manager's office
posts.caption: Earth signs don't leave without snacks

posts.text: dating a taurus venus means being taken to the same restaurant every friday for six years and slowly realising that this is, in fact, the most romantic thing anyone has ever done
posts.caption: Venus at home, loving on a loop

posts.text: your honour, my taurus client did not 'hold a grudge for nine years'. she simply never updated her opinion of him, which is very different and frankly far more efficient
posts.caption: Fixed sign, fixed opinions

posts.text: taurus coworker update: i will be adapting to the new software sometime between never and the day the old software is physically removed from my hands by a team of professionals
posts.caption: Change management has requested backup

posts.text: the taurus has located a soft blanket. it will now remain on this sofa for the rainy season, emerging only to inspect the fridge and silently judge the thermostat
posts.caption: Please do not disturb the grazing

posts.text: i'd be useless as a hostage negotiator because i'm a taurus. my opening offer is my final offer, and i am fully prepared to sit here eating crisps until you agree with me
posts.caption: The bull does not counter-offer

posts.text: the dmv has finally met its match. my taurus sun brought a folding chair, a thermos, a novel and a mid-morning snack, and i am not leaving this building without my licence or a pension
posts.caption: Earth sign endurance remains undefeated

posts.text: people with a taurus rising walk into a room like it's a spa they've already paid for, and somehow everyone else starts speaking more quietly and ordering the nice bread
posts.caption: Venus-ruled ascendant, expensive aura

posts.text: a taurus friend won't text back for four days and then shows up at your door with soup, a plant and an opinion about your landlord. texting is not the love language. presence is
posts.caption: Shows up. Does not reply.

posts.text: terms and conditions for borrowing anything from a taurus: return it in its original condition, on the agreed date, with a small gift for the distress of being apart from it
posts.caption: Venus rules possessions, and it shows

posts.text: let it be known across the kingdom that my taurus moon has opened a savings account for comfort. every payday a fixed amount goes directly to candles, linen and a very good olive oil
posts.caption: Financial planning, earth sign edition

posts.text: nobody warns you that a taurus mars is the calmest person alive for eleven months and then once a year someone takes their parking spot and the whole street learns what a stampede is
posts.caption: Slow to anger, impossible to stop

posts.text: as the taurus maid of honour my speech will be brief, because i have located the dessert table and i would like to be reunited with it before anyone cuts the cake
posts.caption: Priorities were set at birth

posts.text: the weather forecast for taurus season: warm, grounded, zero chance of anyone changing their mind, and a high likelihood of someone 'just popping out for bread' and coming home with flowers
posts.caption: Fixed earth, high pressure system

posts.text: i regret to announce that my gemini mercury has been asked to leave the book club after revealing the ending, three alternative endings, and a rumour about the author's neighbour
posts.caption: Information wants to be free, and so does Gemini

posts.text: take a gemini to a museum and they'll read every plaque, invent a backstory for each portrait, befriend the security guard and leave knowing his ex's full name and his theory about the sculptures
posts.caption: Mutable air, unlimited curiosity

posts.text: dating a gemini venus is incredible because the conversation never stops, the plans change hourly, and three dates in you realise you've been seeing at least two delightful people
posts.caption: Twice the charm, half the punctuality

posts.text: my gemini moon handles feelings by turning them into a podcast. two hosts, both of them me, seven episodes in, still no conclusion, but the guest list is excellent
posts.caption: Analysed, discussed, never actually felt

posts.text: your honour, my gemini client did not lie. she told two different versions of the story to two different people, and both of them were completely true at the time
posts.caption: Mutable sign, mutable facts

posts.text: per my last email, my gemini sun is currently running forty-two browser tabs, three group chats and a side quest about medieval spoons. please hold, your question is tab forty-three
posts.caption: Mercury-ruled multitasking at full volume

posts.text: airport security pulled me aside because my gemini rising made small talk with the scanner, the officer and the sniffer dog, and they assumed nobody is that chatty without hiding something
posts.caption: Just friendly, officer, promise

posts.text: a gemini friend will forget your birthday but remember one throwaway sentence you said in 2019 and quote it back to you at the perfect moment for maximum devastation
posts.caption: Mercury files receipts in the strangest folders

posts.text: honestly a gemini would make a great hostage negotiator. within ten minutes we'd know the kidnapper's star sign, his mum's maiden name, and he'd be rethinking his entire career path

posts.text: a formal statement to mercury retrograde from my gemini placements: we were not consulted, we do not support this, and we will be sending seven voice notes a day in protest
posts.caption: Our ruling planet, our rules

posts.text: tonight's forecast for gemini: scattered opinions, a sudden change of plans around 8pm, and a ninety percent chance of a brand new hobby by morning that will be gone before the weekend
posts.caption: Mutable air, variable conditions

posts.text: as your gemini coworker i'd like to apologise for the 'quick question' that became forty minutes on your childhood, your landlord, and whether birds have favourite people
posts.caption: No question is ever quick

posts.text: having a gemini mars means i don't fight, i debate. you will not leave this argument angry, you will leave confused, slightly impressed and unsure which side you were on
posts.caption: Mars in Gemini wins on vocabulary

posts.text: by royal decree, my gemini sun reserves the right to change her mind about dinner up to and including the moment the waiter is holding his pen. this is a constitutional matter x
posts.caption: Indecision is a sovereign right

posts.text: and here in the waiting room we observe the gemini. having exhausted its phone, it turns to the stranger beside it, and within six minutes they are planning a trip to lisbon together
posts.caption: Strangers are just friends who haven't been interviewed

posts.text: i regret to announce that my cancer moon has once again saved a screenshot of a nice thing someone said to me in 2017. it has been archived, laminated and placed in the vault x
posts.caption: The Moon rules memory, apparently forever

posts.text: put a cancer on a heist crew and we'll pack everyone snacks, knit the balaclavas, refuse to leave anyone behind, and by the getaway the security guard is calling me mum

posts.text: dating a cancer venus means they remember your coffee order after one date, cook your grandma's recipe by the third, and have a drawer at your place by the fourth

posts.text: your honour, my cancer client is not 'avoiding the issue'. she is approaching it sideways, at her own pace, like a crab, which is her legal right as a cardinal water sign

posts.text: the cancer friend will host the party, feed thirty people, refill every drink, ask everyone how their mum is doing, then hide in the kitchen because there are too many people at the party
posts.caption: Hostess with the mostest, now in the pantry

posts.text: drop me in a museum and i'll walk straight past the famous painting to stand in front of a chipped old teacup for forty minutes, wondering whose kitchen it lived in. cancer sun things x
posts.caption: Nostalgic for strangers' grandmothers

posts.text: a formal notice from my cancer placements: the moon is full tonight, our ruler is in charge, and any feelings expressed between 9pm and midnight are non-binding and cannot be used against us
posts.caption: The Moon has the floor

posts.text: people with a cancer rising walk into your flat and within five minutes they've found the good blanket, refilled your water and fed your cat, and somehow you're the guest now

posts.text: as your cancer coworker i have brought in homemade banana bread, remembered everyone's birthday, and quietly written down the name of whoever took the last slice without saying thank you

posts.text: as the cancer maid of honour i've prepared a short speech. it's forty minutes long, there is a slideshow, and i was in tears by slide two. the groom's uncle has now joined me

posts.text: cancer mars energy is being far too polite to confront you directly, so instead i will cook you a beautiful dinner and bring it up very calmly over dessert while you have nowhere to go

posts.text: the forecast for your cancer friend: overcast mornings, a sudden warm front when someone mentions their childhood dog, and tides that rise and fall entirely according to the moon
posts.caption: Ruled by the Moon, tidal by design

posts.text: a cancer hostage negotiator would ask the kidnapper if he's eaten today, make him a sandwich, ask about his mother, and twenty minutes later everyone is home and he's sending me christmas cards
posts.caption: Soft power, and a very good sandwich

posts.text: by becoming friends with a cancer you agree to receive unsolicited soup, check-in texts after every thunderstorm, and a lifetime of being introduced as 'basically family' to strangers
posts.caption: No cancellation policy, just love

posts.text: the estate agent asked why my cancer moon was saying goodbye to each room individually before handing back the keys, and i don't know how to explain that the kitchen and i have history
posts.caption: Cardinal water, deeply attached
